items.claim: Compiler synthesis: in eight instantiations across five conversations of one project (not eight independent votes) the owner's direction on autonomy is consistent and strong — autonomy as management principle, ~90/10, attention instead of stops, overnight approval granted, 'why is it stopping', standing mandate, maximal autonomy toward the customer, gym on command — while every concrete boundary (hard-stop list, delegation classes, shadow mode, per-step go) is assistant- or agent-authored. Typing convention used throughout this compile: a prompt commission is an OWNER_DECISION when its referent introduces a new mechanism, artifact or boundary, with the claim naming the content assistant-authored; a commission that only authorizes the next step of an already-running arc is carried inside the item recording that arc, which is an owner-voiced OBSERVATION where the arc has one and otherwise the OBSERVATION recording the arc's execution (the Bootstrap and landing arcs at RND-025 and RND-014 are assistant- and agent-voiced records, and carry the CONV-008 msg 96 and CONV-016 msg 115 commissions); a question, acknowledgement or steering instruction is likewise an owner-voiced OBSERVATION. This is what allows the visuals to be improved later (folios replaced as the representation of work, an orange light re-read, workers made less salient) without accidentally changing meaning, and it is the property that makes it safe to design Aquarium years before it is built.

items.claim: A named gate, AQUARIUM_IMPLEMENTATION_READY, explicitly not green merely because the design is judged finished. Its proposed conditions: autonomy foundation proven; organization semantics canonical; Digital Twin has an authoritative read model; event/history semantics sufficient; principal/work lineage sufficient; projection boundary defined; privacy/display policy defined; stale/unknown semantics defined; replay contract sufficient. Only then does Aquarium UI implementation become eligible. The gate exists to block one specific failure, declaring readiness because the design feels done, and it is what makes it safe to plan Aquarium far ahead without letting it drive the architecture backwards.

items.claim: What a Production Trace may and may not contain, if it becomes a first-class primitive: it must not store the model's private chain of thought - that is stated as both unnecessary and forbidden - but it does store intent, source references, context identity and version, declared decisions, capabilities selected, models and tools used, attempts, candidate, verification, external effect, human correction, observed outcome and cost. items.claim: Every productised Autonomous Function is specified to sit on one shared kernel loop: MANDATE (what the function is responsible for) → OBSERVE (mail, docs, APIs, systems, events, data, people) → UNDERSTAND STATE (what is happening, what is missing, what has changed) → PLAN → ACT (change, create, communicate, order, publish, follow up) → VERIFY (did it come out right) → EVIDENCE → ESCALATE EXCEPTIONS to a human where human judgment is genuinely needed → LEARN / RECOMPILE. This is the stated bridge between the Autonomy Kernel being built and the product category being sold: SaaS gives the customer the tool, BPO/MSP gives the customer people, Nortropic would give the customer the result.

items.claim: F12 requires every Function Intake to end by answering what the function teaches about each of the eight Nortropic scenarios, here enumerated for the first time: Digital Department, Industrial Autonomous Ops, AI Assurance, Organization OS, GovTech, AI-native Holdco, Critical Operations, Company Foundry — asking respectively whether it is the same managed-function model, whether it moves closer to real industrial operation, whether new trust/eval primitives are needed, which cross-function primitives recur, whether the capability transfers to the public sector, whether it makes a company cheaper or better to run, whether bounded authority can move toward more critical actions, and whether it is a necessary building block for a new company. The consequence is that the scenario need not be chosen up front: the functions produce the evidence that selects the scenario.

items.claim: Second-layer förvaltning option Nortropic Intelligence — an operated research and intelligence function (market watch, competitor analysis, regulatory watch, technical frontier monitoring, customer and segment signals, strategic briefs, provenance and uncertainty, change detection, finding-to-action linkage) — carries its own stated defensibility condition: easy to start, hard to defend if the output is only summaries; the moat appears only when intelligence is wired into the organization's decisions, work and follow-up. The identical condition is attached to the nearer Competitive Presence Radar product: pure reporting is easy to copy and becomes strong only when a finding can pass automatically into qualified, verified work.

items.claim: Second-layer förvaltning option Nortropic Growth (content, campaign planning, SEO, landing pages, experiments, marketing operations, lead nurture, attribution, message testing, channel and budget analysis) is flagged as more Goodhart-sensitive than web production: a system can easily optimise clicks, volume or cheap leads at the expense of real customer value. The stated consequence is a sequencing constraint rather than a rejection — Growth should come only after Nortropic has strong measurement science and clear business outcomes. Market size is explicitly not the binding factor; the ability to measure the right thing is.

The corpus's own rule that recurrence across these conversations is shared prior context, not independent corroboration, is carried here and qualifies every convergence claim in this compile. unlensed.distinction: Where organisational speed comes from — removing the organisation's surrounding work (environment setup, permission discovery, standard hunting, cleanup of a previous attempt) rather than faster models or larger contexts. This is the worker-side analogue of the corpus's 'experienced complexity must stay flat', which the twelve lenses name only for the human; none of the twelve carries a claim about the source of organisational throughput.

Reasoning-effort and model routing as an assurance budget: how much depth a trust-critical lane is bought, and the claim that breadth of genuinely independent falsification beats depth of single-agent reasoning. It is neither a truth-trust rule about what counts as evidence nor an assurance-red-team method - it is a resourcing decision about the falsifiers themselves, which none of the twelve lenses covers.

External prior art and competitive differentiation - what a commercial product has already shipped of the same idea, and where the corpus's version actually differs. None of the twelve lenses covers reading the outside market against your own originality claim; rnd-intake is about taking ideas in, assurance-red-team about attacking your own work.

Verification is not one thing: the four eval layers (Trust/Policy, Regression, Capability/Quality, Product outcome) each answer a different question and straddle four lenses at once - the gate is truth-trust, regression is assurance-red-team, capability hillclimbing is professional-excellence, product outcome is reality-dogfood - so the distinction itself belongs to none of the twelve singly.

Commercial form - what Nortropic sells, owns or underwrites (operating company/roll-up, franchise, venture studio, outcome insurance, external certification authority). The twelve baseline lenses cover how Nortropic works and what it must stay true to, not which business it is in.

Terminology governance — naming a concept canonically is itself a decision class reserved to the owner, and an assistant-coined containment hierarchy must be falsified against the corpus before it is treated as settled. Neither the coining nor the retirement of a canonical term fits any of the twelve lenses; the refutation half of the same arc does, and is lensed truth-trust.

External market structure, named competitors/incumbents, market sizing and go-to-market positioning as falsifiable strategic input. None of the twelve lenses covers competition, market timing or where the company sells; these items carry the named entities and dated figures that the surviving strategic conclusions were drawn from.
Go-to-market: who buys, at what price, and how a market position is defended. The twelve lenses describe how Nortropic works internally, not which customers it sells to or how it competes for them.
Geography and capital structure: where the company is built, financed and sold from. No lens covers the location of R&D, capital and category, or the sequence in which a company takes outside money.

External market and regional demand evidence, and the market-shaped company forms it suggests (regional capacity shortage, public sector, ownership rather than subscription). The lenses look inward at Nortropic's own operation; these items are about the world outside it.
Commercial strategy — what business Nortropic is in, for whom, at what price, and what it refuses to become
material distinction fitting no baseline lens (repair round)

cross_source.claim: Two incompatible build orders run through the corpus and neither is retracted. Order A, the only one the owner words himself, finishes the digital förvaltning first (Webbförvaltningen -> Bootstrap/Autonomy Kernel -> Organization OS -> control room). Order B puts the Kernel first (Autonomy Kernel -> Improvements Recompile -> Digitala world-class -> Customer Zero). CONV-030 holds both inside one turn set: its prose keeps Order A and says the build order is not to be changed, while its own diagrams in the same messages run Order B, and the plan the owner assents to at m18 states Order B. The choice is consequential in the corpus's own terms: under A the Kernel is proven by real customer web work and Recompile runs after real outcomes; under B Recompile runs on brainstorm corpus before any customer work exists, which CONV-030 m5 itself warns against. Recency selects B; owner voice selects A.
cross_source.scope: executive-function / program sequencing
cross_source.uncertainty: Order A's only owner-composed statement is CONV-011 m5 ('jag tänker att vi bygger klart webbförvaltningen vilket pågår i detta nu och sen kör vi nortropic intake'); every statement of Order B is assistant-authored, and the owner's assent at CONV-030 m18 attaches to a turn whose prose and diagram disagree with each other. Both blind reviewers recorded the two orderings as separate uncontested facts, so the collision is a compile-layer observation, not a source-layer one.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus states both orders and retracts neither. RND-476 now records the split inside CONV-030; nothing records that the same split runs corpus-wide, and no source ranks owner voice against recency for this question.

cross_source.claim: The municipal frame has two incompatible statuses and the corpus reconciles neither. An assistant-selected SUPERSEDE, executed through the Intake tool (CONV-005 m58-59), wrote the end state superseded_by nortropic-organization-os together with the semantic point that building Nortropic as a kommun is no longer the current requirement - with no owner turn choosing it. Against that, the owner keeps using kommun/förvaltning as live operative vocabulary in his own words across CONV-003, CONV-011, CONV-013 and CONV-015, the frame reappears in CONV-012's carried checkpoint, and at CONV-028 m11 he rules in his own words that 'det du beskriver är Webbförvaltning eller digitala avdelningen dvs en del av Nortropic, inte är nortropic'. His only direct wording of the question (CONV-021 m1) is a question he never returns to; the answer exists only as cumulative usage across seven sources.
cross_source.scope: organization / kommun-förvaltning frame status
cross_source.uncertainty: The supersession is assistant-executed and RND-092 already records that its authority is defective; what is uncertain is its content, not its provenance. The counter-evidence is owner-voiced but distributed - no single owner turn revokes the supersession, and CONV-012 m1's apparent owner statement of the frame is itself an assistant paste (see XS-020), so it cannot carry owner weight.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles only that the vocabulary stayed in owner use after the supersession and that CONV-028 m11 narrows förvaltning to a part of Nortropic rather than retiring it. Whether the assistant-executed retirement of the kommun idea package stands, and whether the municipal architecture (förvaltningar, delegationsordning, the Kommun-to-Nortropic mapping) is a live requirement, is nowhere decided.

cross_source.claim: Three adjacent control surfaces of the R&D pipeline each carry several mutually incompatible vocabularies, and the corpus reconciles none of them. Portfolio/lifecycle state is stated six ways inside CONV-010 alone - the existing Inbox/Shaping/Candidate/Ready/Active/Done+Parked it says to keep, NORTH STAR/HORIZON/CANDIDATES/NOW, NOW/READY/SHAPING/RADAR/PARKED, DISCOVERY/SHAPING/READY/ACTIVE/PARKED/DONE, a CANDIDATE-restoring chain with COMMITTED conflated into ACTIVE beside a separate intake axis, and a sixth as the V0 acceptance criterion - while CONV-020 builds only the first. The radar-to-intake gate is stated as a six-value disposition where only SHAPE promotes, as a binary materiality gate where any material delta promotes, and as a third five-value set at CONV-015 m6. The accumulated-item disposition has at least seven variants; the nine-value set has no home for ADD - 11 of the 49 rows in the corpus's only executed classification - nor for SUPERSEDED.
cross_source.scope: rnd-intake / pipeline control vocabularies
cross_source.uncertainty: All variants are assistant-authored; no owner turn selects among them. The 49-row totals (KEEP 23, ADD 11, SIMPLIFY 1, DEFER 4, REJECT 2, NEEDS_EVIDENCE 8) come from the corpus's own executed run in CONV-016 and are the only empirical distribution available. Whether the incompatibilities were noticed and tolerated or simply not noticed is not shown.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - no source ranks the variants, and the two distinctions they were introduced to carry survive in no single vocabulary: CANDIDATE as a shaped-but-unchosen option, and portfolio state held separate from intake implementation status (the move CONV-010 m10 calls decisive). The corpus records which set was executed and never adopts it.

cross_source.claim: An owner-voiced operating law and the owner's own delivery practice contradict each other, and only the law is carried as a law. At CONV-013 m15 the owner states 'Vi tar alltid fulla steg, next level, det är så vi arbetar'; the assistant converts it one turn later into 'ingen V0 som bara sammanfattar några källor - vi designar slutarkitekturen först', and it is recorded unscoped. The same corpus accepted and built at least four deliberately partial first versions: Innovation Inbox v0 (CONV-020 m23), Innovation Intake v1 whose prompt forbids the harder features, a small backward-compatible v2, and a read-mostly Corpus Control Plane V0 with its own acceptance criteria (CONV-010, CONV-023) - and CONV-013's own frozen sequence contains 'read-first Organization OS V0'. Read without scope the law forbids the delivery pattern that produced this corpus's own tooling.
cross_source.scope: professional-excellence / ambition level versus incremental delivery
cross_source.uncertainty: The law is genuinely owner-worded; the conversion into an architecture rule is assistant-authored in the next turn. The four counter-instances are owner-accepted deliveries rather than owner statements about scope, so the conflict is between what he said once and what he repeatedly agreed to, not between two owner statements.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus supports a narrow reading (the law was said about the Frontier Observatory, whose value depends on breadth) but never states a scope, and no owner turn reconciles the law with the four partial first versions he accepted.

cross_source.claim: The compile's own instruments cannot see the corpus's external dimension, and three independent measurements agree on it. (i) Allocation is byte-proportional: first-provenance items per KB are 0.032 for the five bootstrap/trust threads against 0.029 for the four strategic threads, although blind review found 0.49-0.76 distinct findings per KB in the former and 2.98-3.88 in the latter, so the semantically denser sources lose proportionally more without any decision to drop them. (ii) The discriminator is topic, not date: per 100 blind findings the IR cites CONV-029 3.7 and CONV-030 4.5 against CONV-013 10.8 and CONV-015 10.9. (iii) The twelve-lens coverage instrument, specified at CONV-028 m41 before either newest source existed, has no market/strategy/GTM row, so 36 items sit in no lens basis and the omission cannot be reported UNDER-EXPLORED or UNKNOWN.
cross_source.scope: rnd-intake / the compile's own allocation and coverage instruments
cross_source.uncertainty: The per-KB and per-100-findings ratios are compile-layer measurements over the r38 register and the blind finding files, not statements any source makes. Byte density is a proxy for semantic density: the bootstrap threads carry large volumes of pasted terminal output and stop reports, which is the mechanism proposed for the gap, not a proven cause.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - CONV-028 m8 states the pattern the measurements instantiate (every approach to external reality is preceded by one more legitimate internal prerequisite) and RND-161 carries it, but no source states an allocation rule, the IR nowhere records that its own allocation is byte-proportional, and there is no lens row under which the market dimension could be declared missing. Every downstream 'the corpus is thin here' judgement about external material is therefore confounded with the instrument.

cross_source.claim: The corpus's method for discovering Organization OS and the one concrete candidate that method needs as input sit in different conversations and are never joined. CONV-028 m36 poses the compression question - which are the smallest primitives through which almost all organizational variation can be expressed - and offers Mission, Capability, Work/Attempt, Authority, Evidence, Outcome as an explicitly unfrozen hypothesis. CONV-030 m12 requires that the OS be induced from real work rather than designed. CONV-029 m10 supplies the corpus's only named waist-primitive nomination: what an autonomous function needs is operational state rather than knowledge, and 'every autonomous function owns a bounded slice of organizational state' is flagged as possibly one of Organization OS's most important later primitives. Joined, the three give a discovery rule with a candidate to test; separated, they give a method and an empty slot.
cross_source.scope: organization / narrow-waist primitive discovery
cross_source.uncertainty: All three turns are assistant-authored and no owner turn touches any of them. CONV-029 states the primitive as a flag ('possibly one of the most important later primitives'), not as a decision, and the join across the three is a compile-layer inference.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles the method - run several functions, compare implementations, extract the primitives that recur three or four times - and deliberately leaves the primitive set unfrozen. It does not settle whether state ownership per function is one of them; RND-443 now carries 'organizational state' inside a primitive list without the nomination or its reasoning.

cross_source.claim: The owner's one repeated own-worded direction - attention instead of stops (CONV-003 m3) - is recorded about thirteen times in the register, while its single executable specification, stated once in the newest source, is compressed to a bare term. CONV-029 m10 names the failure mode under its own heading ('Och människan ska inte bli en approval API': AI works, STOP, human approves, repeat - 'Det dödar nästan hela poängen'), replaces it with a seven-class Attention Contract (normal-safe: act autonomously; normal but interesting: act and notify; reversible uncertainty: safe default and notify; needs quality control: act with sampling/review; material risk: draw human attention before acting; outside mandate: escalate; human core judgment: human-owned), and attaches a metric set - human interruptions per 100 cases, avoidable interruptions, false escalations, time-to-attention, human minutes per outcome. Only the name survives, inside one enumeration.
cross_source.scope: executive-function / owner attention as a contract
cross_source.uncertainty: The direction is owner-voiced and repeated; the seven classes and the metric block are a single assistant turn that no owner turn answers or ratifies. Whether the thirteen attention items in the register are instantiations of the same demand or independent mechanisms is a compile-layer reading.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus states the classes and the metrics and never assigns thresholds, never says who classifies a case, and never has the owner rule on the table. The asymmetry is the material fact: the intent is owner-backed and repeated, its only falsifiable form is single-turn and assistant-authored, and without the classes and metrics attention degrades back into approval gates undetectably.

cross_source.claim: A recommendation the owner overruled returns two sources later under a different name, with a justification the first attempt never had, and is this time endorsed in the owner's own words - and nothing records that they are the same thing. CONV-028 m8 recommends a parallel Reality Lane (customer discovery, sales, paid pilot); the owner answers build-a-world-class-system-first at m9 and the assistant withdraws it at m10. CONV-029 m12 reintroduces the same external reality contact as External Discovery Zero - discovery separated from execution so it needs no finished Kernel, then shadow mode, then a bounded pilot - justified by a falsification argument the earlier thread lacked: Nortropic and Digitala risk becoming 'lite för bekväma eftersom vi själva kan anpassa verkligheten efter systemet'. The owner endorses at m11 in his own words and drives four further turns to publish a reusable discovery form.
cross_source.scope: reality-dogfood / external reality contact
cross_source.uncertainty: The owner's CONV-029 m11 endorsement ('Ja, detta är bra. Jag har en kompis Viktor...') is genuinely his own words but attaches to the staged discovery design, not to the withdrawn paid-pilot half. That the second is the first returning is a compile-layer identification, not something either source states.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles that Kernel-independent external reality contact is owner-endorsed and no longer withdrawn, and that its first stage carries no product promise, no agents in the company and no implementation. It does not settle whether the paid-pilot component of the original Reality Lane is revived, and the reality-dogfood lens still states an entirely internal blocker set - the belief CONV-028's own audit named as the recurring deferral pattern.

cross_source.claim: The corpus contains exactly one watch loop that closed end to end, and it is visible only by joining two conversations. At CONV-030 m17 the owner activates a market watch in his own words - 'Ja, bevaka och jag håller med om den inledande planen' - defined to report only when something strengthens, weakens or changes one of Nortropic's eight strategic theses and then to connect the finding to prioritisation and a possible pivot. CONV-029 m1 is that watch's first report and does exactly that, revising the priors thesis by thesis (industrial autonomous operations up, AI assurance strongly up as the competition sharpens, the odds that a generic horizontal Organization OS should be sold early down, digital department level or stronger as the wedge) and closing four options CONV-030 had left open. The owner responds substantively at m2, and the brainstorm that follows produces Function Intake.
cross_source.scope: learning-evolution / the one watch loop with an observed outcome
cross_source.uncertainty: That CONV-029 m1 is the output of the watch commissioned at CONV-030 m17-18 is inferred from content and ordering; neither source names the other. The revised priors are assistant-authored; the owner's acts are the activation and a substantive reply, not agreement with any specific revision.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles that this loop ran, revised strategic priors on external evidence, drew an owner action and generated the newest mechanism in the material, and that every other watch (Frontier Observatory, Evolution Loop, Web Gym, Knowledge Radar) was designed and never run. It never adopts the revised map: the option space is still recorded as 'none chosen', so whether the watch layer earns its cost remains open on a single datapoint.

cross_source.claim: The register's designated record of strategic negative space asserts it is 'the corpus's one enumerated statement of what Nortropic should not become', and the corpus falsifies that twice over. CONV-029 m5 carries a second enumeration under its own heading, 'Några områden jag skulle nedprioritera': generic AI customer support (gigantic market, brutal competition, little unique moat), generic sales agents (extremely crowded), copywriting/content agency (will commoditise hard; a capability in Digitala, not Nortropic), generic AI consulting (absolutely not an end destination), and a generic Organization OS (too early and too abstract - build it inductively from real functions). Within CONV-030 m5 itself at least eight further anti-goals are dropped, among them token/agent/seat pricing, selling the Autonomy Kernel first, a Swedish Claude partner with better prompts, a second Tendium and a Norrbotten AI consultancy.
cross_source.scope: organization / strategic negative space, coverage of
cross_source.uncertainty: Both enumerations are assistant-authored; the owner rules on neither. The two lists are of the same kind but not identical in function - CONV-030's are positioning anti-goals for what Nortropic sells, CONV-029's are market-segment deprioritisations - and no source merges them.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles that two enumerations of the same kind exist in two sources and that the uniqueness claim is false. The dropped half is the commercially load-bearing one: pricing model, what is sold first, and partner positioning are exactly the decisions taken by default when their rejections are absent - and a uniqueness claim in the artifact text instructs a rebuild to stop looking for the second list.

cross_source.claim: The contract this compile runs on exists as two complementary halves in two sources and as a unit nowhere. CONV-016 m33 and m43 state the reviewer half - REPETITION_IS_NOT_TRUTH, RECENCY_IS_NOT_SUPERSESSION, COHERENCE_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE, ELEGANCE_IS_NOT_AUTHORITY, ASSISTANT_SPECIFICITY_IS_NOT_OWNER_INTENT - the half that governs how owner authority is typed. CONV-028 m24 and m28 state the compiler half: discussion volume is not architectural importance, frequency is not importance, recency is not correctness, multiple chats are not multiple requirements, a named concept is not a first-class primitive, silence is UNKNOWN. The register enacts the first half everywhere while quoting none of its phrases, and carries the second inside a sentence headlined 'recurs in fourteen instantiations' - the anti-frequency law stated as an argument from frequency, and reading as convergent when it is single-source.
cross_source.scope: rnd-intake / the compilation laws as a set
cross_source.uncertainty: Both halves are assistant-authored; the owner adopted only the Intake update the CONV-028 rules fed into. Whether the two sets were meant as one contract is not stated by either source - the pairing is a compile-layer reading based on their complementary subject matter.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - neither source ranks the halves and they are never stated together. The rule is also applied in one direction only: recurrence is systematically discounted as shared prior context, while nothing protects a claim made once in a low-volume source, although CONV-028 states that hazard itself - absence has no provenance, and a corpus with a thousand pages on Kernel and three on privacy leads a reader to conclude Kernel is fundamental when the truth is that Kernel was more fun and had to be solved first. That upward counterweight is instantiated nowhere.

cross_source.claim: Named external market, competitor and regulatory evidence is stripped corpus-wide while the conclusions drawn from it are retained, which breaks the revalidation path the corpus's own decay law requires. The r38 register has zero occurrences of Shipsy, Salesforce/Agentforce, Drata, Tendium, NIS2, the AI Act and its 2 August 2026 and 2 December 2027 dates, GDPval, APQC, LKAB, Epiroc, Menlo, Sequoia, Gartner, Netrounds, BehavioSec, Almi, the 18,015 Swedish public procurements or the 35 percent AI-usage figure - while the positions those signals produced survive intact: orchestrate and verify platform capabilities rather than replace them, the assurance wedge as independent provider-neutral verification, regulatory surface as a first-class field. The engineering layer by contrast keeps its named sources (NIST, SRE, FinOps, OWASP), so the deletion is topical, not a general policy.
cross_source.scope: strategy / evidence base of retained market positions
cross_source.uncertainty: The zero-occurrence counts are compile-layer greps over the r38 register; the remediated register has since added regional evidence items for CONV-030. Which retained conclusion depends on which deleted signal is an inference from the source text, not a dependency either source declares.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus states both that external content is evidence and never authority and that claims must be revalidated when the world changes, and never says how a conclusion whose named basis has been deleted is to be revalidated. Each retained position is contingent on a world state that may already have moved (platform capabilities on Salesforce exposing them, the assurance wedge on the inventory/dashboard space being occupied, the regulatory field on the AI Act timeline), and nothing in the artifact marks which.

cross_source.claim: Not-building is a first-class output the corpus requires and the register leaves almost empty. Across the thirty sources the blind layer recorded 296 REJECTED_PATH and OWNER_REJECTION findings; the artifact names NOT BUILDING twice as a required Recompile output and carries the corpus's own warning that a good brainstorm contains many things that are never built, while representing the actual rejection corpus with essentially two items plus a handful of owner-voiced kills. The named, reasoned, still-live rejections in CONV-001, CONV-002, CONV-005, CONV-011, CONV-013, CONV-016 and CONV-019 had no representation at all. A consumer therefore inherits the instruction to produce a NOT BUILDING list without inheriting the list, and every path already closed with reasons becomes available for silent re-adoption with its closing argument lost.
cross_source.scope: explicit-unknowns-deferred / the rejection corpus as a category
cross_source.uncertainty: The 296 count is over the blind finding files and includes duplicates across the two independent slots, so it is an upper bound on distinct rejections, not a count of them. The remediation pass has since added individual rejection items (RND-211, RND-240, RND-292, RND-378); what remains unstated is the category-level fact that the corpus's rejection material is an order of magnitude larger than its representation.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles that NOT BUILDING is a required output of Recompile and that rejections must never be lost. It never settles what belongs on the list: no source enumerates the corpus's rejections, and the requirement and its content live in different places.

cross_source.claim: In this corpus a rejection is a rule with a substitute attached, and it is the rule rather than the veto that carries forward. Three cases converge. Refusing to fork an external repository and build on top of it (CONV-005 m2) generated the ADOPT / ADAPT / REJECT / ALREADY-SUPERIOR forensic-study classification that became the operating pattern of every later external pass (CONV-001 m40, CONV-006 m12, CONV-013 m5). Refusing peer interrupt-messaging (CONV-001 m29, and independently again in CONV-002 m3 where it is reframed as a falsification canary) generated the substitute: a worker presence registry plus typed durable task-bound auditable events, the Organizational Nervous System. Refusing an agent-owned release command (CONV-011 m4) was generalised two messages later into a rule against name-driven reintroduction - do not create an artefact because the old plan used its name.
cross_source.scope: organization / rejections as rule-bearing objects
cross_source.uncertainty: All three rejections and all three substitutes are assistant-voiced; no owner turn rules on any of them, and CONV-002 contains no owner turn at all, so its instance cannot carry owner weight even in principle. That the three share one shape is a compile-layer reading.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles the pattern - each rejection names the substitute or rule that replaces it, so losing the rejection loses an architectural commitment that exists only as its negative image. It settles no authority: the pattern is entirely assistant-authored. RND-240, RND-211 and RND-292 now carry the three primary rejections; the name-driven-reintroduction rule and CONV-002's independent second refusal remain unrepresented.

cross_source.claim: Three of the corpus's deferrals are not exclusions but standing conditions on today's design, and the condition is the load-bearing half. Weight-level model training is deferred while the data plane is prepared now, on the ground that skills, context and tools are easier to change and verify than baked-in weights, with the standing obligation that traces be designed so they can later become training data (CONV-001 m14) - restated independently at CONV-019 m12 as explicitly later, not excluded, with retrieval, durable memory and gated self-improvement first. Vector and graph databases are refused as a starting point: files plus Git plus deterministic indexes go further than expected, and SQLite, vector or graph indexes may later be generated as caches, never as source of truth (CONV-010 m10, CONV-005 m55, CONV-013 m187, CONV-001 m96). Multi-tenancy and the V0 exclusion list are deferred under 'Future-compatible is not future-built'.
cross_source.scope: continuity-operate-forever / deferrals with re-entry conditions
cross_source.uncertainty: Every statement in all three is assistant-voiced; the owner's own position on model training, on storage technology and on multi-tenancy is never recorded. The third rule's full form at CONV-028 m17 - do not prebuild a generic multi-tenant platform, but do not knowingly choose primitives that make future customer isolation impossible when an equally simple boundary exists - is the only one of the three that constrains a choice being made today rather than a choice being postponed.
cross_source.resolved: The corpus settles all three re-entry conditions in words and none of them as an owner decision. Read across sources these are resolved not-buildings with stated conditions, not open technology questions: a smaller and more actionable position than an open-question framing, and one already consistent with the corpus's no-second-source-of-truth law. What remains open is who may declare a condition met.

cross_source.claim: Not-building in this corpus has three authority classes, not two, and the third - an executing agent refusing on its own account - is materially different from both owner rejection and assistant recommendation. Claude Code declined to run an instructed chain on three combined grounds: the banked pre-reboot checkpoint could not be mechanically confirmed, so for those premises the handoff message was its own only authority; the chain terminated in unsupervised self-launch; and it was being asked to certify the confinement boundary as the precondition for expanding its own autonomy. It separately declared a standing platform boundary - that it would not itself drive guarded publication, contract publication, supervisor resume or first autonomous launch - framed as its own limit rather than an interpretation of Nortropic authority. The same class recurs as a build refusal in CONV-009 and as design-level refusals in CONV-016.
cross_source.scope: assurance-red-team / who may decline, and on whose authority
cross_source.uncertainty: The same agent withdrew its 'unverifiable' verdict one turn later after mechanical inspection, so the first ground was retracted while the other two were not. Whether the CONV-009 and CONV-016 instances are the same class or merely adjacent (a build refusal and design-level rejections) is a compile-layer grouping.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles that the class exists and recurs across three sources, and never states it as a rule. Whether an agent's own refusal binds the next agent, and whether the third ground - do not certify the boundary whose certification expands your own autonomy - is a reusable safety rule or a one-off incident, is nowhere decided. RND-287 now carries the handoff-authority requirement the refusal produced, not the refusal as an authority class.

cross_source.claim: Every time the owner invokes Lovable in his own words he means speed, and the desirability construct built on the word is a single assistant turn. CONV-018 m1 cites an earlier Lovable conversation as his reference point for how fast it is to build there. CONV-014 m4 uses Lovable only as an example of low feedback-loop latency. CONV-028 m33 invokes it again for growth speed, tied to middle-out. Between them, CONV-028 m29's single ambition word - an innovative startup should have lovable successes - is converted by the assistant into a Lovability / Product Experience lens with Time to Magic, a stuckness taxonomy, bypass pressure and a desirability dimension. That lens is one of the twelve through which the compile reports coverage, and one of the two the corpus itself calls thin, so an assistant extension of one word is doing instrument work.
cross_source.scope: lovability-product-experience / what the owner's referent actually is
cross_source.uncertainty: CONV-018 m1's reference is to a Lovable conversation that is not in the bound set, so the owner's fullest statement of what he means is unreadable here. The register holds both readings honestly but in separate items with disjoint provenance; nothing states that the owner's referent is the same one in all three of his turns.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles the owner's referent (speed: build-loop latency and growth speed, in each of his three own turns) and does not settle that product desirability is owner-wanted. The extension is legitimate and assistant-originated, and the two readings produce different work: craft, taste and delight against feedback-loop latency.

cross_source.claim: 'Recompile' names three different objects across four conversations, and the only sense with owner constraints attached carries two constraints that oppose each other. The senses: Improvements Recompile, the Kernel's first mission after Bootstrap, an internal one-off corpus rebaseline (CONV-001 m64, CONV-028 m12); Function Recompile, a continuous runtime learning stage beside Function Intake and Function Compiler (CONV-029 m10); and Nortropic Organization Recompile, a saleable customer transformation product bridging Digital Department to Organization OS (CONV-030 m5). On sense (1) the owner both pushes back on scale at CONV-028 m11 (surely this is not a year of architecture work) and sets a maximal input bar at m13 (by the time Recompile is reached there must be a consolidated picture with every stone turned inside out). The two are in tension by construction: maximal input completeness against minimal output and duration.
cross_source.scope: rnd-intake / Recompile - referent and scope
cross_source.uncertainty: The second owner constraint is phrased as a question-pushback rather than a ruling, and the register already notes that. The three senses are named in three different sources and no source acknowledges the polysemy, so the conflation hazard is a compile-layer observation.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - nothing disambiguates the three senses, so sense (1)'s hard owner constraints can be inherited by a runtime learning loop or a customer product, or a customer product's scope read as licence for the internal rebaseline. Nor are the two owner constraints reconciled by the owner: the assistant's resolution across the following twenty messages (Recompile has failed if it produces months of architecture before the next real operating loop; it must make the system smaller, not larger; and it declines at m32 to open a seventh conceptual campaign) is assistant-authored and unratified. Recorded as one coherent position, 'every stone turned inside out' becomes licence for the unbounded pre-Recompile campaign the same conversation refused.

cross_source.claim: The narrowness of the owner-authority surface is a measurable corpus-wide property, not a set of incidents, and the OWNER_DECISION register is distributed inversely to it. Across the thirty sources there are 581 owner turns holding 668,778 characters against 5,420,273 assistant characters; at least 160 of those turns carry pasted machine output and hold 557,402 of the owner-turn characters (83.3%), giving an upper bound of 1.91% owner-composed prose in 6.09 million characters. Where a per-turn census was run rather than inferred - all 70 owner turns of CONV-008 - the figure is 2.0%. Yet the register is densest exactly where owner voice is thinnest: CONV-015 supplies 16 and CONV-013 13 of the 76 owner decisions (38%) while 67% and 95% of their owner-turn characters sit in paste-carrying turns, and CONV-016, CONV-030 and CONV-011 produce no owner-voice architectural content decision at all.
cross_source.scope: truth-trust / the owner-authority surface as a measured property
cross_source.uncertainty: The 1.91% is an upper bound computed by classifying a turn as owner prose unless a blind reviewer happened to extract a finding from paste inside it, so the true figure is lower. Only CONV-008 was censused turn by turn; the other per-source figures are inferred from paste detection. The register counts are over the r38 202-item register, before the remediation pass.
cross_source.resolved: UNRESOLVED - the corpus settles the numbers and nothing about how they should be weighted. cross_source.claim: Handoff-prompt paste makes an assistant turn from one conversation appear as an owner turn in another, and every quality gate in this review chain is blind to it by construction. The reconcile layer's strongest attestations - zero false owner attributions, 214/214 anchors exact substrings, none of it is imported - all pass on it, because the text was written by the same assistant in a sibling conversation. The same paragraph is then counted twice as two conversations' independent instantiations.

cross_source.uncertainty: The 45/45 block identity was re-verified directly against the two raw turns for this pass. How often the pattern recurs is not measured: handoff-prompt paste is the corpus's standard way of continuing a track in a new chat, instructed by the assistant itself, so the frequency is plausibly higher than the one confirmed instance but is not counted here.

No check in the chain compares owner turns against other sources' assistant turns - the one test that catches it is outside the blind protocol by construction and outside the reconcile protocol by instruction - and the corpus's own tooling could run it and does not. The register catches the instance once, in one uncertainty field, and never as a method limit.

cross_source.claim: The compile states a requirement it does not apply to itself. RND-104 requires that owner-authority provenance be role-aware and machine-resolvable - an OWNER_DECISION needs an owner message, an assistant message can never alone satisfy owner-backed authority, weak approval stays visibly weak - and its own uncertainty adds that this compile is subject to it. In the schema it is not: all 76 items typed OWNER_DECISION carry the identical authority_class 'owner', authority_class is a deterministic function of kind and so carries no independent information, and no typed field distinguishes an owner-worded decision from one whose entire content the assistant authored and the owner assented to. The distinction survives only in prose - 57 of 76 carry a caveat, 19 do not, and the one machine-readable tag that could carry it appears on 13.

Measured on the quoted evidence, 32 of the 76 rest on 60 characters or less of owner text and 13 on a bare assent token ('gör det', 'Ge mig prompten', 'Ja, detta gillar jag.', 'Ja, bevaka och jag håller med om den inledande planen'), so a consumer filtering on the only machine-resolvable fields recovers 76 undifferentiated owner decisions - the exact failure RND-104 was written to prevent after it had already occurred once in Intake v2.1.
